name: Lemon herb chicken with roasted vegetables
dir: Heat oven to 425°F. Toss vegetables with half the oil and season. Coat chicken with remaining oil, lemon juice, garlic and herbs. Roast together 20–30 minutes until chicken reaches 165°F.

name: Grilled pineapple chicken with coconut rice
dir: Marinate chicken in oil, lime and garlic for 15 minutes. Simmer rice with coconut milk, water and salt according to package directions. Grill chicken and pineapple until chicken reaches 165°F. Serve over rice.

name: Lemon garlic chicken and pearl couscous
dir: Season and sear chicken in oil until 165°F. Toast couscous with garlic, add broth and simmer 10–12 minutes or until tender. Stir in lemon and parsley. Serve with sliced chicken. Use rice instead of couscous for gluten-free.

name: Sheet pan turkey meatballs and vegetables
ing: 4 cups broccoli, carrots, zucchini and onion
dir: Mix turkey, egg and crumbs; form meatballs. Toss vegetables with oil. Roast at 425°F for 18–22 minutes until turkey reaches 165°F. Toss with coconut aminos and garlic. Original sauce used soy, honey and sriracha; this version omits them.

name: Crispy ground turkey smash tacos
ing: ½ tsp each garlic powder, smoked paprika and onion powder
dir: Season turkey and press a thin layer onto each tortilla. Sear meat-side down 3–4 minutes, flip and cook 2–3 minutes until 165°F. Top with lettuce, onions, avocado and sauce.

name: Chicken and crispy potatoes
dir: Halve potatoes, toss with oil and seasoning and roast at 425°F for 15 minutes. Add seasoned chicken and roast 18–25 minutes more until chicken reaches 165°F and potatoes are tender. No sauce needed.

name: Chipotle-style chicken bowls
dir: Season chicken with oil, spices, garlic and lime; grill or sear to 165°F. Cook rice and stir in lime juice and cilantro if desired. Warm beans and corn. Assemble bowls with chicken, rice, vegetables and avocado.

name: Cajun turkey sausage pasta
dir: Cook pasta. Brown sliced sausage and vegetables; add broth, cream and seasoning. Simmer 5 minutes and toss with pasta.

name: Smoked turkey sausage rice bowls
dir: Brown sausage and sliced vegetables in oil; season and serve over heated rice.

name: Easy ground turkey meatballs
dir: Mix and roll into 16 balls; bake at 400°F for 18–22 minutes to 165°F.

name: Ground turkey stuffed peppers
dir: Brown turkey, mix with rice and sauce. Fill halved peppers; cover and bake at 375°F for 30 minutes to 165°F.

name: Ground turkey vegetable stir-fry
dir: Brown turkey to 165°F, stir-fry vegetables and aromatics, add soy sauce and toss.

name: Whole roasted chicken
dir: Pat dry, rub with oil and seasonings, place lemon and garlic loosely inside. Roast at 425°F for 60–85 minutes until breast and thigh reach 165°F; rest 15 minutes.

name: Mediterranean turkey and rice skillet
dir: Brown turkey and onion, add zucchini and garlic; cook to 165°F. Stir in rice, oregano and lemon.

name: Mediterranean chicken broccoli and feta skillet
dir: Sear diced chicken to 165°F, add broccoli and garlic with a splash of water; cover 5 minutes. Finish with lemon and feta.

name: Chicken and bacon creamy skillet
dir: Cook bacon, remove; sear chicken in drippings to 165°F. Add garlic, broth and cream, simmer and top with bacon.

name: Ninja Speedi chicken broccoli and brown rice
dir: Place rice and water in pot; set tray above with seasoned chicken. Use Speedi Meals at 390°F for 15–20 minutes, checking rice and chicken (165°F); steam broccoli separately or add near end.

name: Mexican chicken and russet potato skillet
dir: Dice potatoes and pan-fry covered until tender, uncover to crisp. Add diced chicken, onion and spices; cook to 165°F.

name: Gluten-free chicken pizza pockets
dir: Divide dough into 4, fill and seal. Bake at 425°F for 15–20 minutes until golden and filling is hot.

name: One-skillet garlic chicken fried rice
dir: Cook vegetables, scramble eggs, add rice and fry until lightly browned. Add chicken, garlic and sauce; stir-fry until 165°F.

name: One-pan chicken sweet potatoes and spinach
dir: Sauté diced potatoes covered until tender; add chicken and garlic, cook to 165°F. Wilt spinach and season.

name: Sweet potato chicken curry
dir: Sauté onion and chicken; add cubed potatoes, coconut milk and curry powder. Simmer 20 minutes until tender and chicken reaches 165°F.

name: Creamy garlic chicken thigh pasta
dir: Cook pasta. Sear chicken to 165°F, add garlic, broth and cream; simmer and toss with pasta. Speedi option: use Sear/Sauté for chicken and sauce.

name: Creamy rotisserie chicken spinach pasta
dir: Cook pasta; heat garlic and cream, add chicken and spinach, toss with pasta and heat to 165°F.

name: Chicken pesto pasta
dir: Cook pasta and peas; toss with pesto and chicken, heat through to 165°F.

name: Greek chicken bowls
dir: Season chicken with lemon, oil and oregano; sear to 165°F. Serve over rice with cucumber and tzatziki.

name: BBQ chicken flatbreads
dir: Top flatbreads with sauce, chicken, onion and cheese; bake at 425°F for 10–12 minutes.

name: Chicken-stuffed sweet potatoes
dir: Microwave pierced potatoes until soft. Warm chicken with sauce to 165°F; split potatoes and fill, top with onions.

name: Creamy chicken mushroom pasta
dir: Cook pasta. Brown chicken and mushrooms; add broth and cream, simmer until chicken reaches 165°F; toss.

name: Buffalo chicken stuffed peppers
dir: Mix filling, stuff halved peppers and bake at 375°F for 25 minutes to 165°F.

name: Balsamic glazed chicken thighs
dir: Coat chicken and roast at 425°F for 25–30 minutes to 165°F.

name: Coconut chicken lentil curry
dir: Sauté onion and chicken; add remaining ingredients and simmer 25 minutes until lentils soften and chicken reaches 165°F.

name: Turkey sweet potato skillet
dir: Sauté diced potatoes covered until tender; add turkey and onion and cook to 165°F.

name: Ground turkey taco bowls
dir: Brown turkey to 165°F with seasoning. Serve over rice with warmed beans and avocado.

name: Cauliflower crust pizza
dir: Top crust and bake according to package until crisp and hot.

name: Italian turkey sausage peppers onions and crispy potatoes
dir: Roast diced potatoes at 425°F for 30–35 minutes. Sauté sausage, peppers and onions until sausage is cooked through; toss with potatoes.

name: Onion gravy chicken with mashed potatoes and green beans
dir: Sear chicken to 165°F. Sauté onions, add flour and broth and simmer to gravy consistency. Serve with potatoes and steamed beans.

name: One-pan cheesy chicken and rice
dir: Brown chicken and onion; add rice and broth, cover and simmer 20 minutes until rice is tender and chicken reaches 165°F. Stir in cheese.

name: Southwest chicken sweet potato skillet
dir: Sauté diced potatoes covered until tender, add chicken and spices and cook to 165°F. Stir in beans.

name: Chicken meatballs
dir: Mix and shape 16 meatballs; bake at 400°F for 20 minutes to 165°F.

name: Honey mustard chicken
dir: Mix glaze and coat chicken; bake at 400°F for 20–25 minutes to 165°F. Maple syrup can replace honey.

name: Classic pot roast
dir: Season and sear roast. Sauté onion and garlic, deglaze with broth, add herbs and roast. Cover and bake at 300°F for 3–4 hours until fork tender; add vegetables for the last 90 minutes. Thicken juices with cornstarch if desired.

name: Country-style BBQ pork ribs
ing: 1 tsp each smoked paprika, garlic powder and onion powder
dir: Season and sear ribs. Sauté onion and garlic. Add broth and BBQ sauce, cover and bake at 350°F for 1½–2 hours until tender. Uncover, glaze and bake at 425°F for 10–15 minutes.

name: Garlic herb beef shoulder steak
dir: Marinate steak with oil, garlic and herbs for 20 minutes. Sear 4–5 minutes per side or until 145°F, rest at least 3 minutes and slice thinly across grain. Serve with mashed potatoes and green beans.

name: Mustard glazed pork chops
ing: ½ tsp each smoked paprika and garlic powder
dir: Season chops, sear in oil 3–4 minutes per side or until 145°F. Mix mustard, maple and lemon; brush on during final minute. Rest 5 minutes. Maple replaces original honey.

name: Moroccan meatballs with chickpeas
dir: Mix beef, egg, crumbs and spices; form meatballs. Brown in oil, add sliced onion and peppers, chickpeas and broth. Cover and simmer 15–20 minutes until meatballs reach 160°F.

name: Easy weeknight enchiladas
ing: 1 lb ground beef or cooked shredded chicken
dir: Cook beef to 160°F or warm cooked chicken; add seasoning and water and simmer 5 minutes. Fill tortillas with meat and cheese, roll into sauced baking dish, top with remaining sauce and cheese. Bake 375°F 15–20 minutes.

name: Healthy ground beef casserole
dir: Brown beef with onion and garlic to 160°F. Mix with rice, vegetables, broth and seasoning. Transfer to baking dish, top with cheese and bake 375°F 20–25 minutes.

name: Lebanese beef kafta bowls
dir: Mix beef with onion, garlic, parsley and spices except turmeric. Shape 12 patties and sear 3–4 minutes per side to 160°F. Heat rice with turmeric and a splash of water. Mix mayo, lemon and a little garlic; serve with cucumber and onions.

name: Sticky Korean beef and crispy potato bowls
ing: 1 tbsp each ketchup, sesame oil and vinegar
dir: Roast cubed potatoes at 425°F for 35–40 minutes and carrots for 20–25 minutes. Brown beef and onion; add garlic and remaining sauce ingredients. Simmer until sticky. Serve over potatoes with carrots and lettuce.

name: Korean beef rice bowls
dir: Brown beef to 160°F, add garlic and ginger, stir in sauce ingredients and simmer 3 minutes. Serve over rice with green onions.

name: Mediterranean kofta with lemon potatoes and asparagus
dir: Mix beef, onion, parsley and spices; shape patties. Roast potatoes with oil and lemon at 425°F for 35 minutes; add asparagus for last 12 minutes. Sear patties to 160°F.

name: French onion beef penne
dir: Caramelize sliced onions in oil for 20 minutes. Brown beef, add broth, Worcestershire, Dijon and thyme. Simmer 10 minutes; toss with cooked penne.

name: Classic homemade meatloaf
dir: Mix beef, eggs, crumbs, onion and half ketchup. Shape loaf; combine remaining ketchup, sugar and mustard and spread on top. Bake at 350°F for 55–65 minutes to 160°F.

name: French dip sandwiches with au jus
dir: Sauté onion, add broth and Worcestershire; simmer 10 minutes. Warm beef in broth, pile on toasted rolls and serve broth for dipping.

name: Beef stir-fry with cauliflower rice
dir: Sear beef, stir-fry vegetables and garlic, add sauce. Sauté cauliflower rice separately and serve.

name: Killer Angus burgers
dir: Season and grill patties to 160°F. Toast buns, add cheese and sauce and assemble.

name: French onion beef stroganoff
dir: Caramelize onions, brown beef and mushrooms; add broth and simmer. Stir in sour cream off heat; serve over cooked noodles.

name: Smash burgers with caramelized onions
dir: Cook sliced onions slowly in oil until golden. Divide beef into 8 balls, smash on hot skillet and cook to 160°F. Stack on buns with onions and sauce.

name: Low-acidity spaghetti meat sauce with meatballs
dir: Mix beef, egg and crumbs; shape and bake to 160°F. Simmer sauce with carrot 20 minutes, add meatballs and serve over cooked pasta.

name: Crispy beef and potato skillet
dir: Pan-fry diced potatoes until tender and crisp. Brown beef and onion separately to 160°F, combine and season.

name: Sweet glazed pork ribs with roasted vegetables
dir: Season ribs and bake covered at 300°F for 2 hours until tender. Glaze and broil briefly. Roast vegetables at 425°F for 25 minutes.

name: Carne asada bowls
dir: Marinate steak in lime, garlic and oil 15 minutes. Grill to 145°F, rest 3 minutes, slice across grain and serve over rice with avocado.

name: Classic stuffed bell peppers
dir: Brown beef to 160°F; mix with rice and sauce, fill peppers and bake covered at 375°F for 30 minutes.

name: Air fryer salmon bites
ing: ½ tsp each paprika, garlic powder and onion powder
dir: Toss salmon with oil and spices. Air fry at 390°F for 7–9 minutes, shaking halfway, until 145°F.

name: Crispy oven salmon with lemon dill dip
ing: ½ tsp each garlic powder and paprika
dir: Season salmon and bake 425°F for 10–12 minutes or until 145°F; optionally broil 1–2 minutes. Stir dip ingredients together and serve alongside.

name: Lemon garlic tilapia
dir: Pat fish dry, season with oil, garlic and paprika. Bake 425°F for 10–15 minutes until 145°F. Finish with lemon and parsley. No honey.

name: Seared ahi tuna steaks
dir: Mix marinade and coat tuna for 10 minutes. Press into sesame seeds and sear in hot skillet. Original rare method was 45–60 seconds per side; for food safety cook to 145°F, especially for vulnerable diners. Slice across grain.

name: Seafood boil
dir: Boil potatoes with seasoning, lemon and garlic 12–18 minutes. Add sausage for 5 minutes, then crab and shrimp for about 4 minutes until seafood is cooked through. Drain and toss with melted dairy-free garlic butter.

name: Tuna patties
ing: ¼ cup chopped onion and parsley
½ tsp each garlic powder and paprika
dir: Mix ingredients and form 6–8 patties. Pan fry in oil 3–4 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Double all ingredients for 12–16 patties.

name: Tuna stuffed peppers
dir: Mix tuna, mayo, celery, lemon and mustard. Halve and seed peppers, fill with tuna mixture and serve chilled.

name: Tuna zucchini noodles
dir: Sauté garlic in oil, add zucchini noodles for 2–3 minutes. Fold in drained tuna and lemon juice; warm through and season.

name: Salmon patties
dir: Mix, shape 6 patties and pan-fry 4–5 minutes per side until hot and set.

name: Simple oven-baked salmon
dir: Season and bake at 400°F for 12–18 minutes to 145°F.

name: Lemon garlic cod
dir: Season and bake at 400°F for 12–15 minutes to 145°F.

name: Shrimp zucchini noodles with pesto
dir: Sauté shrimp until opaque and 145°F; add zucchini noodles for 2 minutes, toss with pesto.

name: Crispy herb-crusted salmon
dir: Mix crumbs with oil and herbs; press onto fish. Bake at 425°F for 12–15 minutes to 145°F.

name: Shrimp pasta
dir: Cook pasta. Sauté garlic and shrimp to 145°F; toss with pasta, lemon and a splash of pasta water.

name: Blackened salmon (mild)
ing: ½ tsp each garlic powder, thyme and onion powder
dir: Rub fish with oil and spices; sear 3–5 minutes per side to 145°F.

name: Honey sesame tuna bowls
dir: Mix tuna with mayo, honey, sesame oil and soy sauce. Serve over rice with avocado and cucumber. Maple syrup can replace honey.

name: Thick white chicken chili
ing: 1 cup unsweetened dairy-free cream or coconut milk
dir: Sauté onion and garlic. Add broth, beans and spices; mash or blend one can of beans into the soup for thickness. Add chicken and simmer 15 minutes. Stir in cream and warm through. Add broth only as needed.

name: Chicken and gnocchi dumpling casserole
dir: Whisk broth, milk and cornstarch in saucepan; simmer until thick. Stir in chicken, vegetables, seasoning and gnocchi. Transfer to baking dish and bake 375°F 25–30 minutes until bubbling and gnocchi tender.

name: Tomato soup from canned sauce
dir: Sauté onion and garlic in oil. Add sauce, broth and seasonings; simmer 10–15 minutes. Blend if desired and stir in milk without boiling.

name: Dairy-free gluten-free chicken pot pie
dir: Sauté onion and vegetables in oil, stir in flour, whisk in broth and milk and simmer until thick. Add chicken, transfer to pie dish, cover with crust and bake at 400°F for 30–35 minutes until golden and filling reaches 165°F.

name: Rotisserie chicken pot pie with mashed potato topping
dir: Cook vegetables in oil, add flour, broth and milk; simmer until thick. Add chicken, spread in casserole and top with potatoes. Bake at 400°F for 25 minutes to 165°F.

name: One-pan chicken pot pie casserole
dir: Brown chicken in oven-safe skillet, add vegetables and garlic. Stir in flour, broth and milk; simmer until thick. Top with pastry and bake at 400°F for 30 minutes until chicken reaches 165°F.

name: Tuna and veggie rice casserole
dir: Whisk flour into oil, add broth and thicken. Mix with tuna, rice and vegetables; bake at 375°F for 25 minutes to 165°F.

name: Rotisserie chicken enchilada casserole
dir: Layer tortillas, chicken, beans and sauce; top with cheese. Bake at 375°F for 25 minutes to 165°F.

name: Traditional ground beef chili
dir: Brown beef and onion; drain. Add remaining ingredients and simmer 30 minutes.

name: Dairy-free tuna noodle casserole
ing: 3 tbsp each oil and GF flour
dir: Cook noodles. Whisk flour into oil, add broth and milk, simmer until thick. Mix with tuna, peas and noodles; bake at 375°F for 20 minutes to 165°F.

name: Chicken sweet potato soup
dir: Simmer diced ingredients in broth 25–30 minutes until tender and chicken reaches 165°F.

name: Classic turkey chili
dir: Brown turkey and onion to 165°F; add remaining ingredients and simmer 30 minutes.

name: Spaghetti and meatball casserole
dir: Mix meat, egg and crumbs; roll and bake at 400°F to 160°F. Toss cooked pasta with sauce, layer with meatballs and cheese; bake at 375°F for 20 minutes.

name: Killer salsa chicken thighs
dir: Place ingredients in slow cooker; cook low 5–6 hours or high 3–4 hours to 165°F. Shred. Thaw frozen chicken before slow cooking.

name: London broil without onion soup mix
dir: Place onions and beef in cooker, add broth and seasonings. Cook low 7–8 hours until tender; slice across grain.

name: Beef and sweet potato stew
dir: Combine in cooker; cook low 7–8 hours until beef is tender. Season to taste.

name: Pulled pork
dir: Cook pork with onion, broth and spices on low 8 hours until shreddable. Shred and toss with sauce.

name: Chicken vegetable soup
dir: Cook low 5–6 hours to 165°F. Shred chicken and return to soup.

name: Honey garlic chicken
dir: Cook low 4–5 hours to 165°F. Reduce sauce in skillet if desired. Substitute maple syrup if avoiding honey.

name: Lemon herb chicken
dir: Cook low 4–5 hours to 165°F; serve with cooking juices.

name: Teriyaki chicken
dir: Cook low 4–5 hours to 165°F; shred and serve with rice.

name: Chicken curry
dir: Cook low 5–6 hours until potatoes are tender and chicken reaches 165°F.

name: BBQ chicken
dir: Cook low 4–5 hours to 165°F, shred and mix with sauce.

name: Chicken fajitas
dir: Cook chicken and seasoning low 4–5 hours to 165°F; add peppers and onions for final hour. Finish with lime.

name: Salsa verde chicken
dir: Cook low 4–5 hours to 165°F, shred and serve with rice or tortillas.

name: Mississippi pot roast
ing: 1 tsp each garlic and onion powder
dir: Combine in slow cooker; cook low 8 hours until tender. Shred into juices.

name: Classic chicken salad
dir: Chop chicken and celery. Mix all ingredients, adjust seasoning and chill 20–30 minutes.

name: Traditional egg salad (no dill or pickles)
dir: Hard boil eggs, cool in ice water and peel. Chop and mix with remaining ingredients. Chill 20–30 minutes.

name: Classic tuna salad
ing: ½ cup mayo, more as needed
dir: Flake tuna, mix with remaining ingredients and adjust mayo. Chill before serving. No dill.

name: Ham salad
dir: Pulse ham and celery in food processor until finely chopped. Stir in mayo, mustard, onion and pepper. Chill.

name: Killer salmon salad
dir: Flake cooled salmon and mix with chopped vegetables and dressing. Chill or serve over greens.

name: Mediterranean tuna salad bowl
dir: Drain tuna and chickpeas. Chop vegetables and toss everything with oil, lemon and parsley.

name: Tuna lettuce wraps
dir: Mix tuna, mayo, celery, mustard and lemon. Spoon into lettuce leaves and top with avocado.

name: Israeli salad
dir: Dice vegetables finely and toss with parsley, oil, lemon and salt. For tomato-free meals substitute bell pepper.

name: Soy-free poke bowl
dir: Cook rice. Dice cooked tuna and vegetables. Mix coconut aminos, sesame oil and lime; assemble bowls and drizzle dressing.

name: Chicken Caesar wraps
dir: Toss chicken and lettuce with dressing; divide among wraps and roll tightly.

name: Mediterranean chicken salad
dir: Chop and toss ingredients; season to taste.

name: Chicken lettuce cups
dir: Brown chicken with carrot and garlic to 165°F; stir in sauce and spoon into lettuce leaves.

name: Skillet eggs with onions and chicken
dir: Sauté shaved onions until golden. Add chicken and warm. Make wells, crack eggs into skillet, cover and cook until whites and yolks are set. Top with cheese and pickled onions.

name: Tortilla de patatas
dir: Thinly slice potatoes and onion; cook gently in oil until tender. Drain excess oil and mix with beaten eggs and salt. Cook in nonstick skillet until set underneath, flip with a plate and cook until center is set.

name: Soft-boiled eggs
dir: Lower eggs into simmering water for 6–7 minutes. Chill briefly in ice water and peel. Use pasteurized eggs if serving runny yolks to vulnerable people.

name: Strawberry spinach smoothie
dir: Blend until smooth; add ice if desired.

name: Roasted broccoli
dir: Cut into florets, toss with oil, garlic and seasoning. Roast at 425°F 18–22 minutes.

name: Crispy garlic sweet potatoes
ing: ½ tsp each garlic powder, smoked paprika and onion powder
dir: Cube potatoes and microwave 4–5 minutes. Sauté in oil over medium-high heat 6–8 minutes. Add seasonings and Parmesan. Alternatively air fry at 400°F 14–16 minutes.

name: Spaghetti squash
dir: Pierce squash and microwave 3 minutes to soften. Halve, remove seeds and microwave cut-side down in a dish with a little water 8–12 minutes until tender. Scrape strands. Alternatively roast cut-side down at 400°F 35–45 minutes. Serve with cooked ground beef.

name: Garlic reheated carrots
ing: 1 tbsp olive oil or dairy-free butter
dir: Heat oil in skillet, add garlic and carrots. Sauté 5–7 minutes until hot and lightly browned. Finish with thyme and lemon.

name: Garlic mashed potatoes
dir: Boil potatoes and garlic in salted water until tender, 15–20 minutes. Drain and mash with butter and warm milk; season.

name: Sautéed garlic green beans
dir: Blanch beans 3–4 minutes, drain. Sauté in oil with garlic 3–5 minutes. Season and finish with lemon.

name: Dairy-free mac and cheese
dir: Cook pasta. Melt butter, whisk in flour and gradually add milk. Simmer until thick, stir in cheese and mustard. Toss with pasta.

name: Microwave sweet potatoes
dir: Scrub and pierce. Microwave individually 5–8 minutes, turning halfway, until soft; split and season.

name: Cilantro lime rice
dir: Cook rice according to package; fluff with lime juice, zest and cilantro.

name: Seasoned black beans
dir: Simmer beans with spices and water 10 minutes; finish with lime.

name: Chipotle-style fajita vegetables
dir: Slice vegetables and sauté over high heat until lightly charred and crisp-tender.

name: Ninja Speedi home fries
dir: Dice and toss with oil and seasoning. Air fry at 400°F for 18–22 minutes, shaking halfway.

name: Ninja Speedi potato wedges
dir: Cut wedges, coat with oil and seasonings. Air fry at 390°F for 22–28 minutes, turning halfway.

name: Quick pickled onions
dir: Thinly slice onion into jar. Heat vinegar, water, sugar and salt until dissolved. Pour over onions, cool and refrigerate at least 30 minutes. Keep refrigerated.

name: Tartar sauce
dir: Mix all ingredients and refrigerate 30 minutes. Serve with tuna patties.

name: Crazy feta-style topping
dir: Pulse or mash ingredients until creamy but slightly chunky. Chill. Mild version omits hot peppers.

name: Dairy-free cottage cheese
dir: Drain tofu, crumble most into small curds. Blend remaining tofu with yogurt, lemon, yeast and salt. Fold into curds and chill.

name: Burger sauce
dir: Stir together and chill. Use on smash tacos.

name: Buffalo chicken dip
dir: Mix ingredients, bake at 375°F for 20 minutes until hot and bubbly. Use mild sauce to taste.

name: Guacamole
dir: Mash avocado with lime, onion and salt.

name: Dairy-free tzatziki
dir: Grate cucumber and squeeze dry. Mix with remaining ingredients and chill.

name: Homemade vinaigrette
dir: Whisk or shake in a jar until emulsified.

name: Hummus
dir: Blend until smooth, adding water as needed; season to taste.

name: Five-ingredient chocolate mug cake
dir: Mix in a large microwave-safe mug until smooth. Microwave 60–90 seconds until set; cool briefly.

name: Light egg white dessert
dir: Whip whites with cream of tartar, gradually add sugar and vanilla until stiff. Spoon into ramekins and bake 350°F 10–15 minutes until set and cooked through.

name: Hot fudge sauce
dir: Warm cream, cocoa and sugar in saucepan. Add chocolate and stir until smooth. Remove from heat, add vanilla and salt. Serve warm.

name: Easy banana bread
dir: Mash bananas, mix wet ingredients then dry. Pour into loaf pan; bake at 350°F for 50–60 minutes.

name: Whole roasted turkey
dir: Remove giblets, pat dry, season with oil and herbs. Place aromatics loosely in cavity and roast at 325°F for about 2¾ hours, checking breast and innermost thigh reach 165°F. Rest 20 minutes.

name: Homemade turkey gravy
ing: ¼ cup turkey fat or oil
dir: Whisk fat and flour over medium heat for 2 minutes. Gradually whisk in broth and drippings. Simmer until thick; season to taste.

name: Tuna melts
dir: Mix tuna, mayo, celery, onion, mustard, salt and pepper. Butter one side of each bread slice. Build sandwiches buttered side out, with tuna salad and a slice of cheese inside. Cook in a skillet over medium-low heat 3–4 minutes per side until golden and the cheese melts.

name: Spaghetti and meatballs
dir: Heat oven to 400°F. Mix beef, egg, crumbs, garlic, Italian seasoning and salt, then roll into 16 meatballs. Bake 18–20 minutes until they reach 160°F. Warm marinara in a large pot, add the meatballs and simmer 10 minutes. Cook spaghetti according to package directions, drain, and serve topped with sauce and meatballs.

name: Burgers and hot dogs
dir: Heat a grill or skillet to medium-high. Shape beef into 6 patties, press a thumbprint into the center of each and season. Cook 4–5 minutes per side until 160°F, adding cheese for the last minute. Grill hot dogs 5–7 minutes, turning, until heated through and lightly charred. Toast the buns and set out the toppings. Check hot dog labels for gluten and dairy.

name: Breakfast for dinner: pancakes, eggs and bacon
dir: Heat oven to 400°F. Lay bacon on a foil-lined sheet pan and bake 15–20 minutes until crisp. Whisk flour, sugar, baking powder and salt; stir in milk, 1 egg and oil until just combined. Cook ¼-cup scoops on an oiled skillet over medium heat until bubbles form, then flip and cook 1–2 minutes more. Scramble the 8 eggs in the same skillet over medium-low heat until just set. Serve with maple syrup.
